moo.description: <1>MOo</1> is a free desktop application designed to <2>capture, visualize, and analyze multimodal data</2>, enabling the integration of diverse input sources through a plugin system, with support for new sensors and playback formats of captured data. It also allows the execution of <3>research protocols</3> to guide study participants through various activities or tasks.

sdks.intro: <1>MOo</1> also provides <2>official SDKs</2> for plugin developers, including templates and command-line tools to help the development of new plugins.
sdks.ui: Focused on building UI plugins and integrating with MOo’s React/Electron runtime.
sdks.api: Designed for backend plugin development, offering utilities, base interfaces, and packaging/testing tools.

ito.description: <1>MOo</1> is developed by members of <2>InTeractiOn Lab</2>, a research and development laboratory dedicated to studying, developing, applying, and evaluating technology in problems related to information retrieval, human-information interaction, and visualization, using multidisciplinary foundations from information science, computer science, and engineering.
